WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', stat_period_start) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN paid_eligible THEN member_id END AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN paid_eligible THEN order_id END AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN paid_eligible THEN net_sales_cents ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN paid_eligible AND member_month_valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."valid_order_month_facts" valid_order_month_facts_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_repeat_rate) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_avg_order_value) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
    , CAST(SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_17
answer: 2026 年 8 月（完整自然月，全渠道、全门店，统计单位为 CRM 会员账户）青禾的月末付费会员指标为：月末付费会员复购人数 4 个账户；月末付费会员复购率 66.67%；月末付费会员订单均额 47.55 元/单。口径为：先按 2026 年 8 月月末最后一天判断付费会员资格，仅悦享年卡、家庭季卡计入，同一账户多张有效卡不重复计人；再统计这些账户当月全渠道、全门店的有效订单，且不要求订单发生当天也已具备付费资格。复购人数指上述有资格账户中当月至少有两笔有效订单的不同账户数；复购率为复购人数除以月末付费会员购买人数；订单均额为净销售额除以有效订单数。本次结果未按门店或渠道拆分，未返回复购率分母及净销售额明细，因此不展开这些数值。
